repoforge.name: RepoForge Pro
repoforge.tagline: Bootstrap Python projects the right way — once.
repoforge.description: One command. A complete, opinionated Python project — virtual environment, curated dependencies by project type, git init, GitHub remote creation, test scaffolding, and pre-commit hooks. Stop copy-pasting setup boilerplate across every new project.
repoforge.highlight: The "ml-experiment" profile scaffolds experiment and claims registries with falsification discipline baked in — not bolted on.

features.title: Project type profiles
features.body: Choose from ml-experiment, web-api, cli-tool, data-pipeline, and more. Each profile installs the right dependencies and wires the right structure.

features.title: GitHub remote in one step
features.body: Authenticates with GitHub and creates the remote automatically. No manual repo creation, no copy-pasting SSH keys mid-setup.

features.title: Pre-commit hooks included
features.body: Black, isort, flake8, and mypy wired up before you write a single line. Code quality from commit one.

features.title: Test scaffolding
features.body: pytest configured with sensible defaults, a tests/ directory, and a passing smoke test so CI starts green.

features.title: ML falsification discipline
features.body: The ml-experiment profile adds experiment registries and claims tracking — so your research stays honest and reproducible.

features.title: Free Lite on GitHub
features.body: Core bootstrapping is open source. Pro adds the full profile library, GitHub remote automation, and priority updates.

mixin.name: The Mixin Field Manual
mixin.tagline: What actually happens when 300 mods share a method.
mixin.description: Cross-mod compatibility for Minecraft Forge and NeoForge, written from the trenches. Not a tutorial — a field manual for developers who've already read the docs and still can't figure out why their mixin is losing.
mixin.highlight: War stories from shipped Valkyrien Skies × Immersive Portals compatibility work — real conflicts, real fixes, real priority decisions.

features.title: Mixin priority deep dive
features.body: How @Inject, @Overwrite, and @Redirect interact when multiple mods target the same method — and how to win without breaking everyone else.

features.title: Merge strategies
features.body: When mixins compose cleanly, when they silently corrupt each other, and the patterns that make the difference.

features.title: Forge vs NeoForge differences
features.body: The loader divergence matters for mixin behavior. Covers both, flags the gotchas, and explains which patterns are safe on each.

features.title: Real shipped examples
features.body: Valkyrien Skies × Immersive Portals compatibility work dissected — the actual conflicts, the actual fixes, and why each decision was made.

features.title: Debugging playbook
features.body: A systematic approach to diagnosing mixin failures: log reading, conflict isolation, and the tools that actually help.

features.title: Free sample chapter
features.body: Read the priority system chapter before you buy. If it doesn't teach you something, the full manual probably isn't for you.
